_note: Infrastructure, cyber, war and disaster claims from August 2026 videos. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Certain cities are hit with cyber attacks and power grid failures, alongside major earthquakes on the west coast.
mentions.quote: I saw certain cities be hit with cyber attacks
mentions.falsify_match: Cyber attacks causing grid failures in named US cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: No city-level grid failure from a cyber attack.

mentions.claim_text: A D-Day is coming that will be like a Pearl Harbor event, with attempts on Trump and his son coming out of Iran, and Trump buildings needing prayer.
mentions.quote: He said a new Pearl. It will be like a Pearl Harbor event coming
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise mass-casualty attack on the United States traced to Iran.

mentions.claim_text: War stops being war and becomes a great war, with trouble on the water and people in the affected areas needing extra food and water; he links bad weather in the UK to weather manipulation.
mentions.quote: It's no longer going to be war. It will become a great war
mentions.falsify_match: Escalation from regional conflict to a general war.

mentions.claim_text: He is shown a meeting of pharmaceutical and Asian figures contemplating the next virus, taking direction from the devil.
mentions.quote: I saw a meeting and they were contemplating the next virus
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as stated: a private meeting with no names, date or place.

mentions.claim_text: Ukraine strikes on Moscow are the poking of the bear he was told about, and a major escalation follows in the days ahead, with blackouts in Moscow.
mentions.quote: they would poke the bear and there would be a major escalation
mentions.falsify_match: A marked Russian escalation following strikes on Moscow.
mentions.falsify_miss: No escalation in the following weeks.

mentions.claim_text: He cites diesel at eleven dollars a gallon in Germany as part of the plan, tying European fuel costs to the wider design.
mentions.quote: diesel fuel in Germany for their trucks. $11 a gallon
mentions.falsify_match: European diesel prices at that level are verifiable in the record.

mentions.claim_text: Temples of false gods over a thousand years old are shaken down, and a major earthquake comes to California.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake false god temples down that are over a thousand years old
mentions.falsify_match: Major quakes destroying ancient temples in Asia, plus a large California quake.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Australia as the beginning of the temple-shaking he was told about.
mentions.quote: The Lord said, I'm going to shake the Buddha temples down
mentions.falsify_match: The quake record confirms a 7.7 in that region in August 2026.

mentions.claim_text: The Muslim Brotherhood buys mega churches in Minnesota, Michigan and New York and converts them into mosques.
mentions.quote: I saw the Muslim Brotherhood buying mega churches in Minnesota
mentions.falsify_match: Documented purchases of US megachurch properties for conversion to mosques in those states.

mentions.claim_text: An assassination attempt on Trump from a long-range shooter positioned overseas in mountainous terrain, which he says was averted.
mentions.quote: He was he was not in America... he's overseas when this attempt tries to happen
mentions.condition_text: he presents intercession as what averted it
mentions.falsify_match: A reported overseas assassination attempt on Trump.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attempt, though he pre-attributes prevention to prayer.
